# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 103 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 51 | Coptic

---

## Saying 103

Jesus said: "Fortunate is the one who knows which part of the house the robbers are going to break into — that one can get up, pull everything together, and arm for defense before they come in."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Fortunate" — the beatitude formula in contemporary idiom
- "Which part of the house" — the entry point as a specific vulnerability
- "Pull everything together" — the gathering of domain/household
- "Arm for defense" — the preparation as active resistance
